title: Invoice Processing
seo: Invoice processing into your accounting tool
meta: Supplier invoices captured and sent to your accounting software as draft bills for review. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Invoice processing, from inbox to accounting software
overview: Supplier invoices arrive by email as PDFs and someone types them into your accounting tool. We set up a flow that reads each invoice, captures supplier, number, date, tax and totals, and creates a draft bill in your accounting software. A person approves each draft, so nothing is posted or paid without a human looking at it first.

faq: Which accounting tools can you connect?

We work with tools that offer a connection we can use, such as Xero, QuickBooks Online, Wave and Zoho Books. If yours is not listed, send its name and we will confirm what is possible before you order.
No. The flow creates draft bills only, and a person approves them. We do not set up automatic payment, so no money moves without your own decision.
What if an invoice is unclear or has a new layout?
It goes to an exceptions list with the file attached, so a person can enter it by hand. Repeat suppliers can then be added as new layouts.
Do I need to change how suppliers send invoices?
Not usually. We read invoices from an email address or folder you already use. Suppliers keep sending PDFs the same way they do now.
